name: dsfd_wfc_hep_t

job.purpose: S81 sp_wfc priced kit, issue-epoch table for the layer 37/38/39 hidden-row senders, REDESIGNED on a macro (the 2 x 13.3k-flop bank split was refused by the pre-route gate: 72k cells, util 70 %, port f_u[1] on 12,661 loads, CTS failed): one ot_sram_1r1w_512x128 (two users a word, masked write) + 1,024 seen flops + pin flops; pins -> macro address / pin flops -> rd_out register -> compare / +1 -> output register (3 edges; the 2-edge form read macro -> macro -197 ps at the pre-route gate). ~1.2k flops on one root. t_hep moves +3 serial cycles in the kit (start register + this tile): the consumer dsfd_mtp_hrow_src queues the event (valid-driven), benches hep_* / posthep_* / prc_* and mtp_wave mut_hep_stale.
job.structural_change: flop table (26.6k flops, 512:1 read mux from the pins) replaced by one 1R1W SRAM macro with a 3-edge pipeline and two-deep same-user forwarding

floorplan_why: one 174.12 x 29.74 macro (5.2k um2) + ~1.1k flops and the 1,024:1 seen mux (~1.2k um2 std). Outline = the macro + the 20 um macro channels on every side: 220.32 x 77.76 (std utilisation is low by construction; the tile is macro-bound). Cut: 32 b in on W, 36 b out on E over 78 um of M4 face -> 0.04; no through traffic. One clock root, ~1.1k flops + 1 macro clock pin.
